verdict.rationale: pnpm docs describe installing and pinning Node.js per project directly via pnpm (pnpm-docs-4), automatically switching to the version specified in a checked-in `packageManager`/`devEngines.packageManager` field (pnpm-docs-22), and even installing missing runtimes via `pnpm runtime set node lts -g` (pnpm-docs-21/27), plus working as a Node version manager per GitHub README (pnpm-gh-2). This matches the story of per-project runtime pinning from a checked-in config file. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the packageManager-switching workflow in practice, and community comments note corepack support changes (pnpm-comm-18) which add friction/uncertainty around one integration path.
